purpose: Generate reproducible theoretical agent-based cohorts for algorithmic evaluation only.

cohort_rules.G1_Pure_Consumer: consumption-dominant agent; no substantive original contribution
cohort_rules.G4_Iterative_Researcher: iterative contribution with preregistered temporal refinement
cohort_rules.G6_Synthetic_AI: declared synthetic AI agent under fixed generation protocol
cohort_rules.G7_Human_Expert: expert-proxy agent satisfying preregistered qualification rules; not human evidence

randomness: all stochastic draws use the registered seed and deterministic stream partitioning
identity: stable unit_id and UUID5 derived from frozen namespace and canonical unit key
